paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot shows training and validation accuracy as a function of training epoch, illustrating how two accuracy curves evolve across epochs. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 29, with tick labels shown at regular 5-epoch intervals (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 40% to 100%, with major tick labels at 10% increments (40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100). Two solid lines are shown without point markers: a blue line labeled “Train” and a green line labeled “Validation.” The blue training line starts near 46% at epoch 0, rises into the low-to-mid 60% range in the first few epochs (around 64–66% by about epochs 2–4), drops to a low point near 45% around epoch 11, then increases through the mid-to-high 70% range by the mid-to-late teens (around the mid-70s near epoch 15 and around ~80% near epochs 17–18), reaches about 91% near epoch 19, dips to the mid-80% range around epoch 20, and then climbs into the mid-to-high 90s (around ~95% near epoch 21) before reaching 100% by the mid-to-late 20s (about epoch 25) and remaining at 100% through the final epochs. The green validation line starts near 45% at epoch 0, increases to around 57–61% in the first few epochs (near ~60% by about epochs 2–3), fluctuates around the mid-to-high 50% range through about epoch 10, reaches a low point near 42% around epoch 11, then rises gradually through the 50s and 60s (around ~59–60% by about epoch 15–16), climbs into the low 70s (around ~72% near epoch 19), dips to the mid-to-high 60s around epoch 20, and then increases again into the mid-to-high 70s and low 80s, ending near 83% by the final epoch.
